name: Pageree
description: Hosted MCP server for landing pages. The assistant builds a page and saves it as a private preview; nothing goes live until the user approves publishing. Form submissions are delivered to email or a CRM webhook, submission rules hold back spam, pages can run on a custom domain, and per-section visitor analytics let the assistant propose one change at a time. OAuth 2.1 browser sign-in, no API key. Free plan for up to 3 pages with no card; paid plans from $5/month add a custom domain and AI images, each with a 30-day free trial.
author: Pageree
